title: BetterFactions

body:
### BetterFactions is a factions plugin that has a lot of functionality. It adds a lot of commands :
- /fclaim claim
- /fclaim unclaim
- /fmap
- /fadmin delete <factionname>
- /f create <factionname>
- /f invite <username>
- /f join <factionname>
- /f leave <factionname>
- /fc
- /fa
- /fg
- (Other commands are incoming)
> /fclaim adds a claim system, /fmap adds an ASCII map which shows if the chunks around the player are claimed or not (empty squares are unclaimed, green ones are claimed). /fadmin delete <factionname> provides a way for admins to delete factions. /f create <factionname> is for creating factions, /f invite <username> is to invite someone into your faction, /f join <factionname> is to join a faction you were invited into, /f leave <factionname> is to leave a faction you are into, /fc is for chating with faction only, /fa for allys (not working rn) and /fg for global chating.
> 
> Other commands are in the [source code](https://github.com/EyeAmSirius/BetterFaction-2.0.0) but there are not usable yet, they might be in the next update. Feel free to modify the code or to make your customized version of the plugin just remember to cite me in the credits :) !

> Update: forgot to say permissions can be configured via luckperms: betterfactions.* for admins, and betterfactions.command.* for everyone else.
If needed I can provide support on my [discord server](https://discord.gg/qsfEpcSZQ8).
Thanks for reading !

PS: I might post the version 1.0.0 full of bugs and glitches for curious players
